title: Guitar and Rock and roll museum❤️
text:

title: Very interesting
text: This was very interesting with a lot of guitars along with information about them and their musicians. There were several interactive displays which I enjoyed. It was easy to spend a couple of hours here.

title: Spectacular
text: Spectacular museum for rock lovers, you will retrace various eras including records, interactive videos and guitars, a large shop inside, the staff is very kind, and in the evening at the bar there will be a live.Imperdibile event.
author: freddiejknight

title: Go if you love rock!
text: Those who love rock can not miss this experience. A jewel in the heart of the city. The automatic audio guide allows you to take a journey through the best rock from the 50s to the 90s. Authentic memorabilia and photos. Nice atmosphere and ... surprise ending. 😝🤟
author: Milaworldwide

title: GLH rocks!
text: Excellent experience if you're into rock history and/or want to see loads of iconic guitars (some original, some replicas). Very good audio guide that combines general info and lets you choose which guitars you want to know more about. Highly recommended!
author: ccddvv

title: Exceptional experience
text: It is an absolutely amazing museum for people who are into rock music or music history in general. The staff there are lovely, and it's clear that they are passionate about the music. The museum itself has many guitars of famous musicians, and in each room, you feel like you are transported to a different decade. The audioguide was easy to follow and would be interesting for anyone who is at least remotely interested in music. Would absolutely recommend it if you have a couple of hours to spare.
